 CMS Quietly Restores Coverage for Some of 760,000 Removed ACA Enrollees but Will Not Say How Many
 CMS
 ACA
 HealthCare.gov
 KFF Health News
 Insurance
 Health Care
 Fraud
 Covered California
 Immigration
 Social Security
 Some Americans removed from Affordable Care Act plans in a federal fraud sweep have been quietly put back on coverage, but the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services will not say how many. Insurance industry sources told KFF Health News that CMS has reinstated a small number of people whose coverage should not have been canceled.
 More reinstatements could follow, the outlet reported, as enrollees discover they are uninsured when they try to use their coverage. CMS has not disclosed how quickly reinstatements happen or how many cancellations have been reversed.
